data.explanation: Your tax office changed the 2022 assessment because your employer reported changed data. The tax amount is the same as before (€6,918.00), so nothing needs to be paid and nothing will be refunded. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing; the app shows until when. If you agree, no action is needed. Keep the letter with your tax records. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
